metric: AN-05: strong = share of pixels whose largest RGB channel differs by more than 64 after a 3x3 box blur; mean = mean largest RGB channel difference (0-255); heightDifference = |native - Cordova| px at scale 3, after the points a block ends under the tab bar (`hidden`). Each case passes within its value plus `margin`. Measured 2026-11-14 on twios_dev_in07 (iOS 26.5, Xcode 27.2) against the captures of ios/tools/air-reference.

reasons.header blocks (-0): Glyph rasterization of the bar's title and glyphs and the main box's texts; the elements are at the captured positions (strong 0 to 0.0005).
reasons.gauge (-1): The value label is 1 px from the capture: its width is the bold value's width plus 22 pt, and CoreText measures the bold digits up to 1/3 pt narrower than WebKit, which changes the whole-point `offsetWidth` getLabelPosition reads and the label's right border; the band texts start at quarter-pixel positions (x 97.25 pt), where WebKit and CoreText round glyphs to different device pixels.
reasons.chart (-2): Glyph rasterization of the 13 pt labels; the crisp axis: WebKit's 1 pt path covers four device rows (the last one partly) where the native line covers three.
reasons.daily, detail and station cells: Glyph rasterization only; the cells, faces and texts are at the captured positions.
reasons.info (-5, london -3): IN-08's detail AQI table (AirRows): left-aligned table text 1 px (1/3 pt) from the capture, because the table is centered on its widest row and CoreText measures some Korean texts up to 2/3 pt narrower than WebKit (forecast-tolerances.json, detailAir).
reasons.heightDifference 1: The last block ends under the tab bar: WebKit lays the page out on 1/64 pt and rounds each block's pixel edges; the native block ends on the next pixel.
reasons.sensitivity: Mutation checks, run once and reverted (plans/ios-native.md, IN-09): see the plan's checks.
